Struct StyledTextBuilder

Namespace
Tuinet
Assembly
Tuinet.dll

Builds a Tuinet.StyledText into caller memory (usually stackalloc), merging adjacent runs with the same style. Never throws when full: what fits is kept and Tuinet.StyledTextBuilder.Overflowed is set.

var keys = new StyledTextBuilder(stackalloc char[64], stackalloc StyledRun[8]);
keys.Append("j/k", key);
keys.Append(" move  ", dim);
keys.Append(count, key);
buffer.SetText(x, y, keys.Build());
public ref struct StyledTextBuilder
